    AgentFlow agents

    • agents.list List AgentFlow agents
    • agents.get Get an AgentFlow agent and its brief
    • agents.work Get an agent's work queue
    • agents.create Create an AgentFlow agent
    • agents.update Update an AgentFlow agent
    • agents.delete Delete an AgentFlow agent
    • runners.list List AgentFlow runners
    • runners.report Report a runner and its models

    agents.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents MCP agents_list

    List AgentFlow agents

    Agents in the AgentFlow org chart (AI agents, humans, teams and automations), in saved order. Filters: status, kind, live (true: the agents a runner should work), project (id or name) and q (name, role, purpose, inputs, outputs, tools).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    statusenumOne of draft, active, paused, retired.
    kindenumOne of agent, human, team, automation.
    liveboolean
    projectstringProject id or name.
    qstring
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "draft",
        "active",
        "paused",
        "retired"
      ]
    },
    "kind": {
      "enum": [
        "agent",
        "human",
        "team",
        "automation"
      ]
    },
    "live": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Project id or name."
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    agents.work read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/work MCP agents_work

    Get an agent's work queue

    What a runner needs to work as this agent: its brief and its queue, the open DevOps cards delegated to it (cards.update agents, or the card's Delegated to picker). Order: doing, requests, blocked, uat, must, nice (work in progress first; Blocked and UAT wait on others), then soonest due date, then #number. columns narrows the queue, e.g. ["doing","requests"] for cards it can act on now. Report back with cards.update (checklist, links) and cards.move.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    agentstringrequiredAgent id or name.
    columnsstring[]Only these columns (comma-separated in a query string).
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "agent": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Agent id or name."
    },
    "columns": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "requests",
          "doing",
          "blocked",
          "uat",
          "done",
          "must",
          "nice"
        ],
        "description": "Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have)."
      },
      "description": "Only these columns (comma-separated in a query string)."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "agent"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    agents.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents MCP agents_create

    Create an AgentFlow agent

    Add an agent to the AgentFlow org chart. References (reportsTo, supervisor, projects, cards, items) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400, and a reporting loop with reports_loop.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    namestringrequired
    kindenumagent (AI agent), human, team, or automation (a scripted job without AI that runs on its own schedule outside Flow: no models, never live). One of agent, human, team, automation.
    titlestringRole, e.g. Research.
    statusenumOne of draft, active, paused, retired.
    livebooleanThe switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue.
    reportsTostringThe agent it reports to: id or name; "" for top level.
    supervisorstringA person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; "" for none.
    purposestring
    instructionsstringSystem prompt or runbook.
    runtimestringWhere it runs: a runner name from runners.list, e.g. a home server.
    modelsstring[]Model ids the runner reported (runners.list), in order: the primary first, then fallbacks it tries when one fails (or, with auto, the pool it picks from). Also sets model to the first. Wins over model when both are sent.
    modelstringOne model id, e.g. claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5: the same as sending models with just it ("" for none). Always reads back as the first of models.
    autobooleanfalse (the default): the runner starts on the first of models and falls back in order. true: models is a pool and the runner picks one per card.
    schedulestringWhen it runs, in plain words or cron, e.g. "Weekdays 09:00" (the runner starts it then); "" for none.
    jobunionThe runner job it was promoted from: {runner, id} (see runners.report jobs); null or "" for none.
    inputsstring[]What it takes in.
    outputsstring[]What it produces.
    toolsstring[]What it may use.
    projectsstring[]
    cardsstring | integer[]
    itemsstring[]
    xnumberCanvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager.
    ynumber
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120
    },
    "kind": {
      "enum": [
        "agent",
        "human",
        "team",
        "automation"
      ],
      "description": "agent (AI agent), human, team, or automation (a scripted job without AI that runs on its own schedule outside Flow: no models, never live)."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 120,
      "description": "Role, e.g. Research."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "draft",
        "active",
        "paused",
        "retired"
      ]
    },
    "live": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "The switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue."
    },
    "reportsTo": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 0,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "The agent it reports to: id or name; \"\" for top level."
    },
    "supervisor": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 0,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "A person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; \"\" for none."
    },
    "purpose": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 2000
    },
    "instructions": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 20000,
      "description": "System prompt or runbook."
    },
    "runtime": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Where it runs: a runner name from runners.list, e.g. a home server."
    },
    "models": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 10,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 120
      },
      "description": "Model ids the runner reported (runners.list), in order: the primary first, then fallbacks it tries when one fails (or, with auto, the pool it picks from). Also sets model to the first. Wins over model when both are sent."
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 120,
      "description": "One model id, e.g. claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5: the same as sending models with just it (\"\" for none). Always reads back as the first of models."
    },
    "auto": {
      "type": "boolean",

    },
    "schedule": {

      },

      },

    "tools": {

      },

    "projects": {

        ],

      }
    },
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 100,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 200,
        "description": "Timeline item id or title."
      }
    },
    "x": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": -100000,
      "maximum": 100000,
      "description": "Canvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager."
    },
    "y": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": -100000,
      "maximum": 100000
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "name"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    runners.report write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners/{runner} MCP runners_report

    Report a runner and its models

    A runner says what it can run, and optionally which scheduled jobs it found (systemd timers, cron, hosted crons...). The model list replaces the old one when sent (leave models out to keep the stored ones, e.g. when a runner reports the jobs of another machine it reaches over SSH), and so does jobs (leave it out to keep the stored jobs; [] clears them). Nothing is saved when nothing changed, so a runner may report on every pass: a report that only moves lastRun or nextRun is not saved either, unless the jobs were last saved 6 hours ago or more (jobsReported); a changed lastStatus, job or field always is. Agents name the runner in runtime and pick model ids; jobs show in the AgentFlow Scheduled tray, where they can be promoted into the org. A job can carry its full schedule: its timezone, every trigger with its raw expression, where it was read (origin, and the repo file), drift from the live schedule on the platform, and a note on conditions its script applies. Give each model a provider to group it by, and billing: included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use), which runners prefer included models by when picking automatically. Up to 20 runners, 1500 models and 500 jobs each.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    runnerstringrequiredRunner name, e.g. Home server.
    modelsobject[]The models this runner can run (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it).
    models[].idstringrequired
    models[].labelstring
    models[].providerstringDisplay group, e.g. Claude or OpenCode.
    models[].billingenumincluded (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use). One of included, metered.
    jobsobject[]Scheduled jobs on this runner (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it, [] to clear).
    jobs[].idstringrequiredStable per runner, e.g. systemd:backup.timer or vercel:my-app:/api/cron/sync.
    jobs[].namestringDefaults to the id.
    jobs[].sourcestringWhere it is scheduled: systemd, cron, t3, vercel, railway, aside, windows, claude, codex, github or other (any text; defaults to other).
    jobs[].groupstringDisplay group, e.g. "Home server" or "Vercel · my-app".
    jobs[].schedulestringWhen, in words, e.g. "Daily 22:30" or "Every 5 min".
    jobs[].cronstringThe cron expression, when there is one.
    jobs[].timezonestringThe zone its times are in: an IANA name such as America/Phoenix, "UTC", or "local" (the runner's own; see timezone on the runner).
    jobs[].triggersobject[]Every rule it fires on, e.g. each OnCalendar line of a systemd timer or each trigger of a Windows task.
    jobs[].originenumWhere the schedule was read: repo (a config file in a repo; see file), platform (the hosting platform's API) or machine (the machine's own scheduler). One of repo, platform, machine.
    jobs[].filestringThe repo-relative path of the config it came from, e.g. services/worker/railway.json.
    jobs[].driftstringHow the platform's live schedule differs from the repo file, when it does.
    jobs[].notestringConditions the job's script applies itself, e.g. "Exits early when nothing changed".
    jobs[].commandstringA short summary of what it runs.
    jobs[].aibooleanIt starts an AI agent (promoted as an AI agent rather than an automation).
    jobs[].enabledboolean
    jobs[].lastRunstringISO time of the last run.
    jobs[].lastStatusenumOne of ok, failed, running, unknown.
    jobs[].nextRunstringISO time of the next run.
    timezonestringThe runner machine's time zone (an IANA name), which jobs with timezone "local" are in. Left out, the stored one stays.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "runner": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Runner name, e.g. Home server."
    },
    "models": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 1500,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 120
          },
          "label": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 160
          },
          "provider": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 80,
            "description": "Display group, e.g. Claude or OpenCode."
          },
          "billing": {
            "enum": [
              "included",
              "metered"
            ],
            "description": "included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use)."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "description": "The models this runner can run (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it)."
    },
    "jobs": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Scheduled jobs on this runner (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it, [] to clear).",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "Stable per runner, e.g. systemd:backup.timer or vercel:my-app:/api/cron/sync."
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 120,
            "description": "Defaults to the id."
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 40,
            "description": "Where it is scheduled: systemd, cron, t3, vercel, railway, aside, windows, claude, codex, github or other (any text; defaults to other)."
          },
          "group": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 120,
            "description": "Display group, e.g. \"Home server\" or \"Vercel · my-app\"."
          },
          "schedule": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "When, in words, e.g. \"Daily 22:30\" or \"Every 5 min\"."
          },
          "cron": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 120,
            "description": "The cron expression, when there is one."
          },
          "timezone": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 64,
            "description": "The zone its times are in: an IANA name such as America/Phoenix, \"UTC\", or \"local\" (the runner's own; see timezone on the runner)."
          },
          "triggers": {
            "type": "array",
            "maxItems": 10,
            "description": "Every rule it fires on, e.g. each OnCalendar line of a systemd timer or each trigger of a Windows task.",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "kind": {
                  "enum": [
                    "cron",
                    "calendar",
                    "interval",
                    "logon",
                    "boot",
                    "once",
                    "rrule",
                    "manual",
                    "other"
                  ],
                  "description": "cron, calendar (a calendar rule such as systemd OnCalendar or a daily or weekly trigger), interval, logon, boot, once, rrule (RFC 5545), manual or other."
                },
                "expr": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 200,
                  "description": "The raw expression as the scheduler holds it, e.g. \"*/5 * * * *\" or \"Mon *-*-* 09:00:00\"."
                },
                "text": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 200,
                  "description": "It in words, e.g. \"Every 5 min\"."
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "kind"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          },
          "origin": {
            "enum": [
              "repo",
              "platform",
              "machine"
            ],
            "description": "Where the schedule was read: repo (a config file in a repo; see file), platform (the hosting platform's API) or machine (the machine's own scheduler)."
          },
          "file": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "The repo-relative path of the config it came from, e.g. services/worker/railway.json."
          },
          "drift": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "How the platform's live schedule differs from the repo file, when it does."
          },
          "note": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 500,
            "description": "Conditions the job's script applies itself, e.g. \"Exits early when nothing changed\"."
          },
          "command": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 300,
            "description": "A short summary of what it runs."
          },
          "ai": {
            "type": "boolean",

          },

            "default": true
          },

      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 64,

    }
  },
  "required": [
